tweetHighlights.originalTitle: The best model for writing & editing is held back by its harness.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
The best model for writing & editing is held back by its harness.

I just had both ChatGPT and @GeminiApp suggest copy edits for a post that I'm working on.

ChatGPT's suggestions were almost entirely bad but Gemini's suggestions were actually great.

Unfortunately, Antigravity doesn't seem to have working browser use so I basically have to paste all of Gemini's edits back into ChatGPT to make the edits in my browser.

Tweeting this in the hope that Antigravity will get much better much faster.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 最佳的写作和编辑模型却被其束缚所限制。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
最佳的写作和编辑模型却被其自身限制住了。

我刚刚让 ChatGPT 和 @GeminiApp 为我正在撰写的一篇文章提出了修改建议。

ChatGPT 的建议几乎全是错的，但 Gemini 的建议却非常棒。

可惜的是，Antigravity 似乎无法在浏览器中使用，所以我基本上只能把 Gemini 的所有修改粘贴回 ChatGPT，才能在浏览器中进行编辑。

发这条推文是希望 Antigravity 能尽快改进。

A bit last minute, but really excited about this new event series that I'm hosting called Slice for Thought 🍕💭

First guest up is @PeterJ_Walker, head of insights at @OpenRouter (previously @cartainc) this Wednesday, Nov 4th at noon. 

> 60 minute sessions (IRL only) in SF
> For the first 45 mins, I get to ask the guest spicy questions about their expertise
> For the last 15 mins, they get to ask me anything they want to learn about venture
> All off the record, chatham house rules
> Every Wednesday with some pizza slices for lunch
> Open to 10-12 guests who listen in and can ask some of their own questions

Register here if you want to join us for the first edition, and subscribe to the Luma for future guests: https://t.co/37gFCJNKKr

> 60分钟的线下活动，地点在旧金山
